title: Owens' brain operated on beside a circle of tarantulas on a Texas highway

tellings.quote: driving along a highway in Texas as I recall. And [snorts] one day he found himself um on the road next to his car or truck as it was surrounded by a whole circle of tarantula spiders.

plain: A man named Ted Owens, who claimed psychic powers, said that one day while driving on a highway in Texas he suddenly found himself standing on the road beside his car or truck, which was surrounded by a whole circle of tarantula spiders, and the story goes that his brain had been operated on there. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a PhD and studies psychic claims, tells it as Owens told it to him, adding "as I recall" about the details. To Owens it would mark the moment unseen beings changed him.
